name: steward
description: Lightweight goal agreements for software work. Frame the result and essential boundaries, critique material gaps or needless restrictions, and assess outcomes while leaving builders room to adapt.

interface.shortDescription: Clear goals with room to adapt
interface.longDescription: Keep software work aligned through short goal agreements. Frame the desired result and essential boundaries, critique material gaps or unnecessary restrictions, and assess the work using proportionate evidence. Builders can change their approach while user decisions control changes to the goal. Agreements live in conversation or Markdown with no freezing or command-line lifecycle.
defaultPrompt: Frame this request as a short goal agreement.
Critique this agreement for gaps and needless restrictions.
Assess whether this work achieved the agreed goal.
